## What changes and why

<!-- One change per pull request. Say what the user sees differently. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit tests; a user-facing flow also has an end-to-end test in `e2e/`)
- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass
- [ ] The README, the help text and the website follow a change of behaviour
- [ ] A change to a data file in `~/.quiver` carries a format version and keeps reading the older one
- [ ] The commit subjects follow Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): ...`, `fix: ...`, `docs: ...`)
